tei:div.tei:p: 39) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs tig las: nor lha'i sgrub thabs dngos grub bum bzang bzhugs: 40) na mo pad+ma kā ra ye:

dus gsum rgyal ba'i phrin las dpal: yon tan yid bzhin dpal mnga' ba: 'gro 'dul ār+ya dzam bha la'i: rtsa sgrub zab mo 'di ru bstan: sa ma ya: sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las: dang po skabs 'gro sems bskyed ni: na mo: bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can kun: byang chub snying po ma thob bar: skyabs gnas rnams la skyabs su mchi: 'gro rnams srid las sgrol ba'i phyir: smon 'jug don dam byang sems bskyed: lan gsum dang yan bdun ni: ho: rab 'byams rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor la: phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul sdig pa bshags: dge la yi rangs chos 'khor bskul: dam pa mya ngan mi 'dar bzhugs: dge tshogs 'gro ba yongs la bsngo: 'gro kun sangs rgyas pa thob shog: de nas bgegs srung ni: hūm̐: nga bdag gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i bgegs: chos dbyings mtha' bral klong du phaṭaḥ ye shes rang gdangs rdo rje'i gur: mi 'gyur mi shigs klong rgyas gdab: u tsa ta ya phaṭa: badz+ra rak+ṣa bh+rum̐: byin dbab mchod rdzas byin brlab ni: hūm̐: dbyings dang dbyings bzhugs ye shes lha: mi gnas chos 41) sku'i klong nas bzhes: sku dang ye shes dbang dngos grub: sgo gsum bum pa'i snod du bskyil: sku gsung thugs kyi dbang byin phobs: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i sprin: kun bzang mchod sprin lta bur gyur: pheṃ dza ma hā pū dza ho: gnyis pa dngos gzhi bsgom pa ni: ā: chos rnams mi dmigs de bzhin nyid: kun snang gdangs las snying rje'i rtsal: bh+rūm̐ yig yongs su gyur pa las: lhun grub bde chen zhing khams su: rin chen sna tshogs gzhal yas khang: tshad dang mtshan nyid rab rdzogs dbus: rin chen khri steng pad zla dang: nyi steng dbul sri bsnol gdan du: rang rig yi ge dzam mthing nag: de las 'od zer rab 'phros pas: rgyal ba mchod cing dbang byin bsdus: 'gro ba'i sgrib dag bde la bkod: dpal yon dwangs bcud ma lus bsdus: yongs gyur rang nyid skad cig gis:

ār+ya dzam bha la nag po: zhal gcig zhi ma khro 'dzum brjid: phyag gnyis g.yas kyis bhan dmar dang: g.yon pas nor skyug ne'u le 'dzin: dbu skra dmar ser sku rgyab 'phyangs: thod 42) skam dar sna'i cod pan bcings: sku la dar dang rin chen brgyan: zhabs gnyis gyad kyi 'dor stabs bgrad: liṅga sgreng zhing 'od dmar gyis: 'khor 'das gzi byin dpal yon sdud: ye shes 'ja' 'od 'khrigs pa'i klong: snang la rang bzhin med par gsal: gnas gsum rdo rje'i snying po las: 'od 'phros dbyings bzhugs rgyal ba rnams: nor lha gter bdag rnam rol du: spyan drangs bskyed pa'i lha la bstim: de nas spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol ni: hūm̐: rnam dag chos dbyings pho brang nas: ye shes sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i lha: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dam tshig ye shes gnyis med par: 'ub chub ngang du brtan par bzhugs: 'dod dgu'i dpal yon dngos grub stsol: badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥtiṣ+ṭha lhan: de nas phyag 'tshal mchod pa ni: na mo: lha dang rang snang dbyer med pa'i: yongs grub rig pas phyag 'tshal lo: dngos su 'byor dang yid sprul gyi: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa'i tshogs: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes phyir 'bul: bzhes la mchog thun dngos grub stsol: ma hā sarba pañtsa pū dza hoḥ de nas bstod dang bshags pa ni: hūm̐: rgyal 43)ba kun gyi yon tan dpal: 'dod dgu rin chen gter mnga' ba: nor bdag ār+ya dzam bha la'i: sku gsung thugs la gus pas bstod: sbyin dang gtong phod chung ba yis: nor lha'i thugs dang 'gal ba bshags: bzod gsol tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: yi ge brgya pa brjod mthar 'dzab dmigs ni: hūm̐: rang nyid lhar gsal thugs ka ru: pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan steng du: ye shes rang 'od lnga ldan dbus: thugs srog dzamaḥyig mthing gsal gyi: mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor: 'od 'phros rgyal mchod dbang byin bsdus: sgo gsum dkyil 'khor gsum du rol:

mar 'phros snod bcud dpal yon dang: dwangs bcud tshe dang bsod nams srid: tshur 'dus srog gi snying por bstim: tshe dpal yon tan rab rgyas shing: las kun thogs med 'grub par bsam: oṃ ār+ya dzam bha la dza lān+d+ra ye sarba sid+dhi 'dus swā hā: de ltar gsal dag brtan pa'i ngang: smra bcad mi tshig ma 'dres par: bye ba gcig gis grub par nges: sa ma ya: gsum pa rjes rim tshogs mchod ni: bza' bca' la sogs ci 'byor dang ཿ snang srid mchod pa'i phyag rgyar sprul: de nas byin gyis brlab pa niḥ oṃ: 44)snang ba'i dngos po thams cad kun: āḥ zag med ye shes bdud rtsir bsgyur: hūm̐: kun bzang mchod sprin bla med rdzas: rgyal ba'i zhing khams yongs khyab gyur: nam mkha' mdzod sngags lan gsum gyis brlabs: de nas tshogs la spyan 'dren ni: hūm̐: byang phyogs rin chen gter gyi gzhal yas nas: rgyal ba'i yon tan las sprul nor gyi bdag: dzam lha rigs lnga sprul 'khor bka' sdod bcas: rmad byung gsang ba'i tshogs kyi gnas 'dir gshegs: sgrub rten brten pa'i rdzas dang gnyis med bzhugs: longs spyod nor gyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: ār+ya dzam bha la sarba sa ma ya dza dza pheṃ: de nas mchod bskang bshags pa ni: hūm̐: ye shes bdud rtsi bla med rdzas: 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di: rtsa gsum dam can srung ma dang: gter bdag nor lha'i tshogs la 'bul: gnyis med bde chen ngang du rol: khyad par thugs mthun mchod pa'i rdzas: nyer spyod bdun dang 'dod yon lngas: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: sman gtor rak+ta dza gad skyems: gsang ba'i mchod pas= bkra shis rdzas dang rin chen bdun: lha klu mi yi longs spyod dpal: ye shes 'phrul gyi rnam rol du: 45)dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis sprul: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: rtsa ba sku gsung thugs dang ni: yan lag bsgrub bya'i dam nyams pa:

dkyil 'khor lha tshogs spyan snga ru: 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pas bshags: mi sgrib tshangs par mdzad du gsol: ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la khā hi: badz+ra sa ma ya shud+dhe āḥ de nas bsgral bstab niḥ hūm̐: ma rig gnyis 'dzin ru tra kun: ye shes thun me mtshon gyis bsgral: rang grol bde chen klong du bstab: 'khrul med ye shes sa thob shog: mā ra ya rbad phaṭaḥ khā hi: de nas lhag gtor ni: pheṃ: dpal gyi bka' nyan lhag sdud tshogs: 'dir gshegs lhag ma'i 'dod yon rol: gnas skabs mthar thug legs yon kun: 'bad med 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod: uts+tsiṣ+ṭa bā liṃ ta khā hi: de nas chad mdo brtan skyong ni: hūm̐ bh+yo: sngon tshe rgyal ba'i spyan snga ru: khas blangs dam bcas bstan skyong ba'i: srung ma dam can gter bdag dang: bod khams skyong mdzad ma mo'i tshogs: bshal chu'i gtor ma 'di bzhais la: bcol pa'i phrin las 46)yongs 'grub mdzod: ma bh+yo dza i daṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi: de nas rta bro brdung ba ni: hūm̐: ye shes rol pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: log par 'dren pa'i ru tra kun: mnan no phyag rgya bzhi yi 'og: sku gsum lhun grub bro rgyas gdab: nam yang ldang bar ma gyur cig: s+t+waṃ bha ya nan: de nas dngos grub bskul ba ni: mi gnas ye shes dkyil 'khor lha'i: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyi: dngos grub dam pa gang lags pa: sgrub mchog bdag la bstsal nas kyang: don gnyis lhun grub dpal thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar: kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ de nas bshags pa bsngo smon ni: hoḥ bdag ni ma rig bag med pas: bskyed bzlas ting 'dzin g.yel ba bshags: dge tshogs 'gro ba yongs la bsngo: bla med byang chub myur thob shog: de nas bsdu ldang ni: hūm̐: thabs kyis bskyed pa'i ye shes lha: shes rab stong nyid dbyings su āḥ rjes snang ye shes sgyu ma'i sku: rgyan dang cha lugs rdzogs par bsgom:

rtsa sngags: de nas bkra shis ni: hūm̐: srid zhi mnyam brdal chos sku'i klong: sku dang ye shes yon tan dpal: bdag cag rnams la bstsal nas 47)kyang: 'ja' lus zang thal bkra shis shog: ces dang gzhan yang bkra shis brjod: 'dir 'phrad skal ldan skyes bu yi: bsod nams longs spyod ngang gis 'phel: bden brdzun lag tu longs dang gsal: skal ldan bu dang 'phrad par shog: log lta can la 'di ma 'phrad: bka' srung tshogs kyis gnyer gyis shig: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: brda thim: : ces pa 'di yang skyabs rje grub dbang rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyi dngos slob bya bral ba dge btsun dam pa o rgyan skyabs kyis dbang mdog lha reg skyes bcas nan cher bskul ngo ma ldog tsam du tha shal ba kun bzang chos nyid dbang mos ser dgon dben gnas mtshams khrod 'od gsal ljongs nas bris pa'o// dge'o// 48)
